app_description: Targeted binary patches for classic games
help: Show this help message and exit
version_help: Show the WASDify version and exit
json_help: Output structured JSON with stable keys and codes
plan_help: Validate a selected set without writing files
apply_help: Validate and apply a selected set
game_help: Game ID; manual choice does not bypass compatibility checks
patch_help: Patch ID; repeat to select several patches
invalid_arguments: Invalid arguments. Check the command syntax with --help.
patch_conflict: Patches {patch} and {conflict} conflict. Change the selection.
dependency_cycle: Dependency cycle involving {patch}. Correct the patch definitions.
signature_count: Expected {expected} signature matches; found {actual}. The file is incompatible or ambiguous.
single_file_only: This version supports one main executable per operation.
invalid_change: Invalid change at file offset {offset}. Check the patch implementation.
unexpected_bytes: Unexpected bytes at file offset {offset}. The file is incompatible.
overlapping_changes: Changes overlap at file offset {offset}. Change the patch selection.
ambiguous_game: More than one game matches. Game detection needs more precise signatures.
game_mismatch: Selected game {game} differs from detected game {detected}.
unknown_file: Unknown executable. Choose a game manually; patch signatures must still pass.
not_implemented: Patch {patch} is a placeholder. No implementation is available yet.
implementation_missing: Implementation is missing for {patch}. Correct the registry.
invalid_analysis: Patch {patch} returned an invalid analysis. Correct the implementation.
io_error: Cannot read {path}. Check the path, regular-file status and access permissions.
backup_failed: Could not create a verified backup at {path}. Check permissions and free space.
write_failed: Could not write {path}. Check permissions and free space; inspect any saved backup.
file_changed: File {path} changed after analysis. Check it again before applying.
plan_blocked: This plan has blocking issues. Resolve them and check again.
plan_changed: The patch plan changed. Check it again before applying.
gui_unavailable: Tkinter GUI is unavailable. Use a Python installation with Tcl/Tk and an active desktop.
unexpected_error: An unexpected error occurred. Check the installation and try again.
unknown_hash: The hash is not in the known-version database. Only patch checks can establish compatibility.
no_changes: No changes needed; selected patches are already applied
backup_manual_restore: To restore, close the game and copy the backup over the target executable.
backup: Save a backup next to the executable
choose_file: Choose the game's executable, then check the selected patches.
selection_changed: Selection changed. Check the selected set before applying.
unsupported_executable: The file is not a supported 16-bit NE executable, or its segment table is damaged.
dos_help: Arrows: select/change  Enter: open  Esc: back  Del: clear binding
dos_conflict: Duplicate or invalid keys. Check bindings. Press any key.
dos_write_error: Write failed. Check access and .TMP/.BAK files. Press any key.
weapon_selection_fix_description: Safely reselect weapons without dereferencing the current weapon pointer.
invalid_pak: Cannot read a compatible WASDify.pak. Check the archive beside WASDify.exe.
resource_language_required: Cannot uniquely identify the game language for additional files.
rollback_failed: Rollback incomplete. Changed paths: {paths}. Recovery files: {recovery}. Backups: {backups}.

prototype_load_fresh_only: Restart the prototype to load a snapshot.
prototype_closed: Game closed. Saved games remain in the prototype directory.
prototype_temp_blocked: A .TMP EXISTS. MOVE IT OUT TO SAVE
prototype_recovered: GAME LOADED FROM A RECOVERY RECORD
